parse_turk_annotations: run the script to parse MTurk annotation CSV outputs and compute worker agreements and disagreements
process_result: process a single MTurk annotation row dict into a structured action dictionary with worker ID and words
process_dict: process a flat key-value dict with dot-separated keys into a nested dictionary structure
handle_components: handle and transform annotation component dicts for tag_val, filters, schematic, or location child types
resolve_spans: resolve word span indices in annotation dicts back to actual words from the input sentence
